taskBaseInfo.taskDescription: Gate-C AMP training + fixed 5-seed eval with CORRECTED autograd context. Root cause of TASK_067/079 eval crash: eval called env.reset_idx manually under torch.inference_mode(False) (exits inference mode) -> illegal inplace update on gym inference tensors. Fix: run eval rollout inside torch.inference_mode() (matches amp_on_policy_runner.py:105 training context), rely on env internal auto-reset, never call reset_idx manually, act_inference policy, fixed vx=0.5. Trains x1_amp 2000 iters (seed=5, 4096 envs, GMR Gate-B expert) then 5-seed eval (5/17/42/123/2024, 4 eps, vx=0.5 m/s nominal dynamics). HEAD 3064f7d. Frozen thresholds in data/task_spec.md.
